title: Windows 32-bit 4.6 editor does not launch.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.6-dev2/3/4. Present in both mono & non-mono.
- Not reproducible in Godot 4.5.1, 4.6dev-1, any 4.6 64-bit snapshot.

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 256V (8 threads) - 15.54 GiB memory

### Issue description

Launching the 32-bit version of 4.6 (Excluding dev-1) causes the editor to crash on launch.
I do not think this is related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/113111

I've included the entire log since the property not found warnings are not present in the 64-bit versions, or in the 32-bit dev-1 version.
